    chips = {}
    duplicates_ignored = 0
    missing_values = 0

    for row in rows:
        chip_id = row["chip_id"]
        test_item = row["test_item"]
        value = row["value"]
        unit = row["unit"]
        lower = row["lower"]
        upper = row["upper"]
        retest = row["retest"]

            raise ValueError(f'Invalid unit: {unit}')

        if unit == "mV":
            value = float(value) / 1000
            lower = float(lower) / 1000
            upper = float(upper) / 1000

        value = value.strip()
        if not value:
            missing_values += 1
            continue

        value = float(value)
        lower = float(lower)
        upper = float(upper)
        retest = int(retest)

        if (chip_id, test_item, retest) in chips:
            duplicates_ignored += 1
            continue

        passed = lower <= value <= upper
        chips[(chip_id, test_item, retest)] = passed

    passed_chips = [chip_id for chip_id, results in chips.items() if all(results.values())]
    failed_chip_ids = [chip_id for chip_id, results in chips.items() if not all(results.values())]

            "chips": 0,
            "passed_chips": 0,
            "yield": 0.0,
            "failed_chip_ids": [],
            "duplicates_ignored": 0,
            "missing_values": 0,
        }

    yield_value = len(passed_chips) / len(chips)
    yield_value = round(yield_value, 4)

    return {
        "chips": len(chips),
        "passed_chips": len(passed_chips),
        "yield": yield_value,
        "failed_chip_ids": sorted(failed_chip_ids),
        "duplicates_ignored": duplicates_ignored,
        "missing_values": missing_values,
    }
